name: code-quality
description: Audit the quality of a Rust codebase from measurements: complexity, coverage, CRAP, churn, change coupling, duplication and advisories, ranked so the agent reads the risky code first

interface.shortDescription: Audit a Rust codebase from measurements
interface.longDescription: A collector script measures complexity, coverage, CRAP, churn, change coupling, duplication, escape hatches and dependency advisories in a Rust workspace. The skill tells the agent which code to read from that ranking, how to judge it, and how to report findings against a saved baseline.
defaultPrompt: Audit the code quality of this Rust workspace.
Compare this repository with its quality baseline.
